nodes.description: Public transfer(address Kaven, uint Duong) function that only emits the DoSomething event; it has no access control, no state variable usage and no explicit return despite declaring returns (bool).
First parameter of transfer: address Kaven, forwarded to the emitted DoSomething event.
Second parameter of transfer: uint Duong, forwarded to the emitted DoSomething event.
State-changing event emission emit DoSomething(Kaven, Duong) inside an unguarded public function, allowing any external caller to trigger it, and the function returns no boolean value as declared.

edges.reason: Parameter Kaven is read directly in the body of the transfer function.
Parameter Duong is read directly in the body of the transfer function.
Parameter Kaven is passed as the first argument to emit DoSomething.
Parameter Duong is passed as the second argument to emit DoSomething.
The public transfer function has no access control or authorization check, so any external caller controls execution of the emit DoSomething state-changing operation.

normalization_plan.reason: Kaven is a non-core parameter whose only use is being forwarded as an argument into the core unsafe operation emit DoSomething; merging it removes a redundant auxiliary node.
Duong is a non-core parameter whose only use is being forwarded as an argument into the core unsafe operation emit DoSomething; merging it removes a redundant auxiliary node.
